title: The 8 Best Edge Router Bit 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for edge router bit 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at edge router bit 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Freud 99-024 Corner Beading Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Classical cove and bead profile, TiCo carbide, Bottom bearing.
strengths: The classical cove-and-bead is the most traditional furniture edge profile -- found on period and Shaker furniture
TiCo carbide produces the smooth, consistent arc that makes this profile look refined rather than machine-made
Bottom bearing follows curved and straight edges equally
One of the most versatile decorative edge profiles for furniture of any style
limitations: Profile is visible and distinctive -- not appropriate for all furniture styles
Single profile -- cannot adjust to different height positions for different sub-profiles
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Freud 38-100 Roman Ogee Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Roman ogee profile, TiCo Hi-Density carbide, Bottom bearing.
strengths: Roman ogee is the most widely used decorative edge profile for cabinet doors and furniture
Quadra-Cut geometry produces a cleaner, more consistent ogee profile with less tearout
S-curve ogee profile works on straight and curved edges identically with the bearing guide
The reference choice for woodworkers making cabinet doors and frame-and-panel furniture
limitations: Smaller diameter than premium large-scale ogee bits
Roman ogee is a visible, traditional profile -- may not suit modern or minimalist designs

products.name: Freud 40-104 45-Degree Chamfer Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 45-degree chamfer, TiCo carbide, Bottom bearing.
strengths: 45-degree chamfer is the correct edge profile for contemporary and mid-century modern furniture
Clean, geometric profile that reads as intentional rather than decorative
TiCo carbide produces a chamfer line that is straight and consistent across the full edge
The correct edge treatment for modern furniture where a roundover would look dated
limitations: Adjustable height for different chamfer widths -- but at a fixed 45-degree angle
Not appropriate for traditional or period furniture styles

products.name: Freud 97-204 3-Piece Cabinet Door Bit Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Cabinet door edge profile, Works with matching rail-and-stile set, TiCo carbide.
strengths: Cabinet door profile is designed to match the inside edge of rail-and-stile sets
Produces the traditional raised panel door edge found on most kitchen cabinets
TiCo carbide produces smooth, consistent profiles at the feed rates required for cabinet door production
The starting point for building traditional kitchen cabinet doors
limitations: Requires the matching rail-and-stile set for complete door making
Profile is fixed -- cannot adjust the door edge independently

products.name: Yonico 17150 Router Bits Set 15 Bit, 1/2-Inch Shank
products.blurb: Key specs: Multiple edge profiles, Roundover, cove, chamfer, ogee, Budget price.
strengths: Set covers roundover, cove, chamfer, and ogee profiles for the price of one premium bit
Good for experimenting with different edge profiles before committing to premium bits
Yonico carbide produces adequate results in softwood and furniture-grade plywood
The practical starting set for woodworkers new to decorative edge routing
limitations: Yonico carbide dulls faster than Freud or Whiteside in hardwood
Profile consistency is lower than premium bits
Larger case includes bits beyond basic edge profiles

products.name: Freud 36-126 Beading Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Single bead profile, Bearing-guided, TiCo carbide.
strengths: Single bead is the most refined, subtle edge profile for fine furniture -- associated with period and Arts and Crafts styles
TiCo carbide produces a consistent, smooth bead that looks like a hand-plane result
Bearing guides the profile consistently on curved and straight edges
The correct edge treatment for fine furniture where the profile should complement rather than dominate
limitations: Very subtle profile -- may not be noticeable on dark or highly figured wood
Single size -- bead diameter is fixed

products.name: Freud 30-104 Cove Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Cove profile, TiCo Hi-Density carbide, 3/8-inch radius cove.
strengths: Cove is a concave arc profile -- used as the starting profile for complex combined edge treatments
TiCo carbide geometry is precise -- the arc is a true radius, not an approximation
Used in combination with beads and flats to create complex period-furniture edge moldings
Reasonable price for a true-radius cove bit compared to boutique brands
limitations: Smaller radius than some traditional molding combinations call for

products.name: Freud 91-100 13-Piece Super Bit Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Multiple edge profiles, TiCo carbide throughout, Roundover, chamfer, ogee, cove.
strengths: TiCo carbide on every profile in the set -- no quality compromise on any individual bit
Covers the four most common decorative edge profiles in furniture and cabinet work
All bits in the set use the same carbide specification -- consistent quality level
The correct one-purchase solution for woodworkers setting up an edge routing toolkit
limitations: May include profiles that see limited use initially

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
